feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.7
entry.summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port.

entry.title: MPC Tape Echo 1.3.0
entry.summary: Three-head tape echo with a spring tank: 12 head and reverb modes, tape saturation, wow and flutter, tempo sync, live VU.

entry.title: MPC DJ FX 2 3.2.0
entry.summary: One-slot live DJ insert for MPC/Force: 3-band isolator, DJ filter, beat repeat, delay, reverb, through-zero flanger, grain delay, limiter, and eight performance macros measured from Lenny Kiser's DJ-FX rack.

entry.title: LUFest 0.1.1
entry.summary: Loudness meter for the master channel's effects: momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, LRA, 4x oversampled true peak, held L/R sample peaks, green/yellow/red level bars with a CLIP lamp, and large readouts. Audio passes through untouched. Tested on an Akai Force; numbers not yet checked against a reference meter. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: KutilXXL 0.3.4
entry.summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables across three screens: Wave Bard on Bastl's open-source Kastle 2 DSP plus Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC. Patch by touching jack-group windows and pressing CONNECT; a preset window holds 36 factory patches and 16 user slots with multi-tag filtering. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: Wreck 0.3.0
entry.summary: A self-sampling sound design instrument: ten sources (noise, clicks, your own WAV files from any folder or drive, FM, attractors and more) run through five blocks in any order into a 20 second loop that MIDI voices play back, and the voices can feed the chain again. 4-lane polymetric arp, bouncing-ball delay, 22 presets. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: VADER 0.9.1 (beta)
entry.summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, 35 maths shapes, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) or one of 27 modes across four corners. Each corner plays overtone generators, one of 14 voices, or a WAV sample. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects. Its screen runs on your phone: scan the QR code, load shapes from the phone too.

entry.title: reMixXXL CUE 0.1.3
entry.summary: Companion to reMixXXL: plays reMixXXL's PFL cue (decks 1/3 left, 2/4 right) on its own audio track routed to outputs 3/4, so you can beat match in the headphones while the main mix stays on 1/2. Needs reMixXXL 0.1.25 or later in the same project.

entry.title: reMixXXL 0.1.25
entry.summary: Four Mixxx-engine DJ decks for the Force: CDJ-style jog wheels you spin with a finger (VINYL scratches, CDJ nudges the pitch), mixer, two effect units, a track browser, a phone/PC companion page and Mixxx controller maps, with a big-button touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: reMixXXL 0.1.22
entry.summary: Four Mixxx-engine DJ decks for the Force: CDJ-style jog wheels you spin with a finger (VINYL scratches, CDJ nudges the pitch), mixer, two effect units, a track browser, a phone/PC companion page and Mixxx controller maps, with a big-button touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.2.0
entry.summary: The MPC as a USB audio interface: its outputs and inputs as channels on the computer, next to its MIDI ports. Works where the device port is wired to the USB-B socket (Key 37 verified; One, One+). Not on the Force, Live II or X: their USB-B port sits behind the internal hub in standalone mode; use force-link-audio there.

entry.title: MORI 0.3.1
entry.summary: A love letter to MEMENTO | Enjoy-Lab, with its own circuitry programmed by logic. A tempo-synced DUB loop you can record into, a stereo tempo delay, a multi-head and grain TEXTURE memory, reverb with shimmer, a bipolar filter and master FX, joined by a 14-way routing matrix. Five pages. MPC OS 3.x.

entry.title: Retrolooper One (MPC) 0.3.9
entry.summary: Stereo Audio looper for MPC with host sync, overdubs, touch/MIDI and WAV export. Native Controls are optional.

entry.title: Retrolooper One (Force) 0.2.10
entry.summary: Stereo Audio looper for Akai Force with host sync, overdubs, touch/MIDI and WAV export. Native Controls are optional.

entry.title: πToniC 1.0.0
entry.summary: Eight-voice percussion synthesizer with oscillator and noise sound design, 150 Patternarium kits, per-voice sends, shared reverb and delay.

entry.title: πClideaN MPC 1.3.2
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.0
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.2
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion, from redistributable recordings and original synthesis. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.0
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: SamplerFilter 1.1.3
entry.summary: A late-80s rack-sampler style 6-pole low-pass (no resonance) with the sampler's bit-depth and sample-rate grit, drive and mix.

entry.title: Roads 1.2.2
entry.summary: A 16-voice electric piano from mda ePiano's samples and modelling, with tine, reed and clav characters, tremolo / auto-pan, chorus, a note-triggered envelope filter and a 3-band EQ.

entry.title: PotentialWax 1.2.2
entry.summary: Melodic sampler in the spirit of Serato Sample: picks or browses songs from your own folders (MP3, WAV or FLAC), detects tempo and key, sets 16 cue points (phrases, bars or hits) on the pads and matches them to your tempo and key, with time-stretch or vinyl-style pitching. Save the chops as WAVs.

entry.title: PotentialPunch 1.0.2
entry.summary: Transient shaper: more or less punch at the start of every hit and more or less tail after it, level-independent with no threshold, speed and focus (full/lows/highs), soft clip, live meter and 12 one-tap presets for drums, breaks and more.

entry.title: PotentialNoise 2.0.2
entry.summary: Calibrated pink noise reference for the pink-noise mixing method: one-tap RMS levels from -24 to -12 dB, mono or stereo, full or 40 Hz-16 kHz range, live RMS and peak reading and a level meter.

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.0.1
entry.summary: Soft clipper and bus saturator: push drums, breaks or a whole beat into a warm curve (soft, tape or hard) that rounds the peaks off instead of clipping, with tone, ceiling, level match, mix, a live meter and 12 one-tap presets. Pairs with PotentialPunch.

entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.4
entry.summary: Drum-break slicer: picks a random break from your own break folders (WAV or FLAC), chops it to 8 or 16 slices or by hits across the pads and matches it to the project tempo, by re-pitching or stretching. Shuffle the slices and save the groove as MIDI.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.4
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, sung doos, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, delay, reverb and sub. 96 presets; a CRT crystal-ball orb reacts as you play. Gen1 (MPC OS 3.x, plus an OS 2.x zip) and Gen2.

entry.title: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.1.0
entry.summary: Hold 16 Levels on the MPC Sample to play its 16 slots in a scale (8 scales, any root), starting from the sample's own note (MPC's, or heard in the audio when untagged). A SCALE page shows the notes and lights the one you play. Recorded hits keep their notes. Needs the MPC Sample Draw Handler for the page.

entry.summary: Add, remove and turn on or off the plugins in a project's inserts from a RACK page on the Sample. APPLY saves and restarts MPC: save first.

entry.title: MPC Remote 1.2.0
entry.summary: The MPC screen in a browser, and an MCP server so an AI model can see and touch it, play MIDI and read files. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.2.0
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: MonoSlide 1.0.4
entry.summary: Monophonic acid bass voice with overlapping-note slide, velocity accents and an MPC touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Keyscope 1.1.0
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

entry.title: HexChord 73 1.0.1
entry.summary: Stereo chord synthesizer with four engines, eight chords, four voicings and a touchscreen chord diagram.

entry.title: Crate Digger 1.3.1
entry.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade, region and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into an MPC track, with its own screen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: Breaks 0.9.6
entry.summary: Plays a drum break in time with the song while the transport runs: 16th slices retriggered on the song grid, through the whole break whatever the loop length, with pitch, bit and sample-rate grit, time-stretch grains, half time, seeded variations and pad effects. Bring your own breaks.
